Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a two-vehicle collision in Conroe, Texas, where the vehicles came together in a
low-speed head-on impact. Driver 1 was operating the first vehicle and Driver 2 the second. A Passenger was also
seated in the first vehicle at the time of the crash. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and said the
impact pushed them forward and back against the seat. The damage to both vehicles is consistent with the reported
direction and force of the collision, and the front-end deformation on the first vehicle matches the contact area on the
second. No earlier damage to the first vehicle was found in the inspection or known to the owner. Officers confirmed
through the scene and statements from both drivers and the Passenger that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle when it
was struck. Photographs tkaen at the scene confirm several details of the account, though no independent witnesses
came forward. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the first vehicle. Officers documented the
scene, issued no citations at the time, and forwarded the report for follow-up.
